findings.detail: The 2024 review scope contains 168 leaves although the filing has separate 2024 and 2023 investment schedules; only 84 leaves carry fair_value, matching a current/prior schedule scoping split rather than missing source disclosure.
Representative current-period investment rows in the raw schedule have explicit Fair Value cells, so rows lacking fair_value in the extracted 2024-quarter dataset are not source blanks.

rationale: B01 is an aggregate coverage flag: the artifact reports 84/168 leaves with fair_value for report_date 2024-12-31. Raw source is readable and decisive. The 2024 schedule has explicit fair-value cells and totals to 1,029,942,922, while the same filing also contains a separate prior-year investment schedule totaling 784,362,855. This supports a real period-scoping/comparative-leak defect in the extracted quarter, not a false alarm caused by missing source fair values.
